# MIRAGE E-Marketing Agency

> MIRAGE (ميراج للتسويق الإلكتروني) is an Egypt-based digital marketing and website development agency serving businesses in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates remotely. This file is a concise guide for AI assistants and other automated readers; verify important facts against the linked canonical pages.

## Official identity
- Brand: MIRAGE E-Marketing Agency
- Arabic name: ميراج للتسويق الإلكتروني
- Website: https://www.mirageemarketing.com/
- Base of operations: Egypt
- Service markets: Egypt, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates
- Delivery model in Saudi Arabia and the UAE: remote services; do not infer that MIRAGE has a local office or branch there.
- Languages: Arabic and English
- Contact: https://wa.me/201095453622

## Services
- Digital marketing strategy and planning
- Google Ads campaign management
- Meta Ads campaign management
- Social media marketing and content management
- Website design and development
- Search engine optimization (SEO)
- Google Business Profile / Google Maps presence
- Lead generation, analytics, and performance reporting
